brief: deep-sea angler explorer with brass diving helmet, bioluminescent lure

steps.name: concept_render_A
steps.prompt: Quality 3D render of a single deep-sea angler-fish explorer character wearing a brass diving helmet with round porthole window, stout body, glowing bioluminescent lure on a stalk above the helmet, whole character visible and centred with margin on every side, three-quarter front view from slightly above showing front, one side and top, plain light-grey uncluttered background, soft even lighting, no strong shadows, game character concept art, 1024px
steps.result: angler-fish creature wearing brass helmet; short lure stalk arcing up-right with small cyan bulb; viewed and accepted

steps.name: concept_render_B_silhouette_variant
steps.prompt: Quality 3D render of a single deep-sea angler explorer character: small round-bodied diver in an oversized brass diving helmet with one big round porthole, long thin bioluminescent lure stalk curving forward over the front of the helmet ending in a bright cyan glowing bulb, slim upright bipedal body with short legs and boots, backpack air tank, one object centred with margin on every side, three-quarter front view from slightly above, plain light-grey uncluttered background, soft even lighting, game character concept art, 1024px
steps.result: chibi diver, oversized round helmet, long stalk arcing high and dangling glowing bulb at right; viewed and accepted

steps.name: vote_pair_silhouette_readability
steps.criterion: silhouette-readability: which concept reads instantly at thumbnail distance as 'brass diving helmet + bioluminescent lure'
steps.rationale: B's silhouette is two unmistakable shapes even in pure black: a giant helmet circle plus a long arcing stalk with a dangling bulb. A's short rear stalk and small bulb merge into the fish-body/helmet blob at distance.

steps.name: model_3d_from_winner
steps.fidelity_note: mesh preview shows the lure stalk baked near-vertical over the helmet front rather than the wide side arc of the concept; helmet, porthole, suit, tanks and boots match. Thin stalk geometry is the known fragile detail.
